name: Desert Temples
description: Cross wind-scoured ruins and descend into a buried temple of the sun. Read the old signs, salvage water and relics, and confront the guardian of the sealed heart chamber.

items.name: Bronze Khopesh
items.description: A curved bronze blade with a leather-wrapped grip.

items.name: Reed Shaft Spear
items.description: A long spear with a bronze point and a tightly bound reed shaft.

items.name: Sun Ward Shield
items.description: A round wooden shield painted with a faded sun disk.

items.name: Linen Armor
items.description: Layered linen reinforced with small bronze scales.

items.name: Water Skin
items.description: A sealed skin of cool water recovered from a shaded alcove.

properties.use_message: You drink deeply from the water skin.

items.name: Date Ration
items.description: A small packet of dates wrapped in palm fiber.

properties.use_message: The dates are sweet and filling.

items.name: Oil Lamp
items.description: A clay lamp with enough oil to light the painted corridors.

properties.use_message: The lamp catches, throwing warm light across the carvings.

items.name: Bronze Seal
items.description: A bronze seal marked with the temple's sun emblem.

items.name: Lapis Signet
items.description: A blue stone signet cut to fit the lock of the heart chamber.

items.name: Scarab Amulet
items.description: A glazed blue amulet shaped like a scarab.

items.name: Gold Leaf Token
items.description: A palm-sized offering token covered in flaking gold leaf.

items.name: Painted Coffer
items.description: A cedar coffer painted with lotus flowers, still held shut by a bronze clasp.

items.name: Sun Reliquary
items.description: A stone reliquary from the temple's innermost shrine.

npcs.name: Lost Cartographer
npcs.description: A dust-covered surveyor sheltering beside a toppled column, clutching a charcoal map.

nodes.body: 'The sun court hides a coffer behind the western relief. I marked it before the sand erased my tracks. Watch for loose floor tiles near the offering hall.'

responses.text: I will follow your map carefully.

npcs.name: Temple Keeper
npcs.description: An elderly keeper tending a sheltered lamp and brushing sand from a wall of names.

nodes.body: 'The jackal guardian holds the lapis signet. Its post is below the pillared hall. Leave the old offerings undisturbed until you know which doors they mark.'

responses.text: Tell me where the pillared hall lies.

nodes.body: 'Follow the blue ceiling stars into the deeper rooms. The exit opens beyond the heart chamber.'

enemies.name: Sand Scorpion
enemies.description: A broad, pale scorpion that bursts from a seam in the warm sand.

enemies.name: Tomb Jackal
enemies.description: A lean jackal with dust-caked fur and eyes fixed on the next opening.

enemies.name: Mummified Sentinel
enemies.description: An ancient guard wrapped in crumbling linen, still gripping a bronze spear.

enemies.name: Bronze Idol
enemies.description: A heavy temple idol whose jointed arms grind to life when the shrine is disturbed.

enemies.name: Jackal Guardian
enemies.description: A towering jackal-headed guardian clad in tarnished bronze, keeping watch over the heart chamber.

descriptions.text: A stair of sun-bleached limestone descends beneath a half-buried gateway. Wind drives sand across the first steps, but the painted sun above the arch is still visible.
A narrow gate opens toward the dunes and the first clear sky seen since the stair. Blue inlay traces the final threshold of the temple.
Slanted light reaches a court choked with sand. Behind a weathered relief, a painted cedar coffer rests where offerings were once collected.
A ring of tall pillars surrounds a sealed stone reliquary. Gold paint catches the lamp light, and a jackal-shaped shadow falls across the only path forward.
Drifts pile against carved walls, leaving a narrow trail between them. Fresh tracks vanish where sand spills from a crack overhead.
Wind whistles through a slit in the masonry. Fine grit has polished the lower carvings almost smooth.
Rows of painted columns disappear into the dimness. Their capitals hold traces of blue and gold, and broken pottery lies between the bases.
Low stone tables hold empty bowls and dried flower stems. A few floor tiles sit unevenly beneath the layers of dust.
Reed pens and shattered ink pots scatter across a long desk. Faded symbols record shipments of grain, oil, and blue stone.
Cool air rises from a deep stone basin. A little clear water remains below the rope marks on its rim.
Niches line the walls beneath a ceiling painted with blue stars. Several linen wrappings have fallen across the passage.
A fallen roof slab has crushed one side of the shrine. The surviving wall shows a procession carrying lamps toward the temple's inner rooms.
A narrow recess lies behind a displaced stone panel. Scratch marks around its edge suggest someone searched it recently.
Tiny blue stones set into the ceiling form a trail toward the deeper temple. A bronze brazier stands cold beneath them.
Fine sand whispers across the floor and gathers in every footprint.
A trace of old lamp smoke clings to the stone ceiling.
The air turns cool beneath the heavy stone, far from the heat above.
A hollow knocking travels through the pillars and then stops.
Faded painted figures carry offerings along the wall toward the inner shrine.
Grit shifts beneath your boots, exposing the edges of older floor tiles.

config.objective: Defeat the jackal guardian and recover the lapis signet.

config.secret: The western relief conceals a small offering niche.
Search the wall carvings for a recessed shelf.
